first_error_evidence: Step 1 fails immediately with '/bin/sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail' — the shell environment uses /bin/sh which does not support pipefail, so the entire provisioning command aborts before any packages are installed or configuration is applied.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent attempted a full provisioning one-liner in /bin/sh twice (failing on pipefail then heredoc chaining syntax errors) before successfully executing the same setup wrapped in 'bash -lc' on the third try.
